----DEPOSITS

---3.1(Total MTD ADB)
SELECT BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.BalanceAmount, BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId, BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId
INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId
AND BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.SerialNumber = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.SerialNumber
INNER JOIN BNKM.Customer ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CoreCustomerId = BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId
WHERE 
BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J') AND
BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'Average Current Balance' AND
BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
GROUP BY BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId, BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.BalanceAmount


---3.3 (Total Outstanding Balance)
SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, A.CustomerAccountId, SUM(A.BalanceAmount) AS TotalOutstandingBalance
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT  a.CustomerAccountId, a.PeriodStartDate, a.BalanceAmount
            FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance a
                WHERE a.PeriodStartDate = (SELECT MAX(b.PeriodStartDate) 
                FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance b
                WHERE a.CustomerAccountId = b.CustomerAccountId AND
                a.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND
                a.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP')) as A
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId
            AND BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.SerialNumber = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.SerialNumber
            INNER JOIN BNKM.Customer ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CoreCustomerId = BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId
            WHERE 
            BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J')
            ----AND
            ---BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodStartDate = '20230112'
            GROUP BY BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, A.CustomerAccountId



-----LOANS


---3.4 (Total Relationship Exposure)
SELECT BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, A.CustomerAccountId, SUM(A.BalanceAmount) AS TotalRelationshipExposure
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT  a.CustomerAccountId, a.PeriodStartDate, a.BalanceAmount
            FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance a
                WHERE a.PeriodStartDate = (SELECT MAX(b.PeriodStartDate) 
                FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance b
                WHERE a.CustomerAccountId = b.CustomerAccountId AND
                a.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND
                a.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS')) as A
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId
            AND BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.SerialNumber = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.SerialNumber
            INNER JOIN BNKM.Customer ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CoreCustomerId = BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId
            WHERE 
            BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J')
            ----AND
            ---BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodStartDate = '20230112'
            GROUP BY BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, A.CustomerAccountId
